key_decisions.rationale: Preserves contrast, hearing, faith, male count, and approximation.
key_decisions.before: But many who had heard the word trusted, and the number of men came to about five thousand.
key_decisions.after: But many who heard the message believed, and the number of men grew to about five thousand.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But many of those who had heard the word believed, and the number of the men became about five thousand.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps conditional frame, scrutiny, benefaction, man’s condition, and healing.
key_decisions.before: if we are being examined today because of a good deed done for a sick man, and you are asking how he was made well,
key_decisions.after: if we are being examined today for a good deed done to a man who was weak and asked how he was healed,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: if we are being examined today concerning a good deed done to a weak man, by what means this one has been made well,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps identification, rejection, builders, and cornerstone image.
key_decisions.before: This Jesus is ‘the stone rejected by you, the builders, which has become the cornerstone.’
key_decisions.after: This Jesus is ‘the stone rejected by you builders that has become the cornerstone.’
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: This is the stone that was rejected by you, the builders, which has become the cornerstone.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves exclusivity, name, heaven, human sphere, necessity, and salvation.
key_decisions.before: Salvation is found in no one else, because there is no other name under heaven given among humanity by which we must be saved.”
key_decisions.after: Salvation is found in no one else, for no other name under heaven has been given among humanity by which we must be saved.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And there is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given among men by which we must be saved.”

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps leaders’ perception, social assessment, reaction, and recognition.
key_decisions.before: When they saw Peter and John’s boldness and realized they were uneducated, ordinary men, they were amazed and recognized that they had been with Jesus.
key_decisions.after: When they saw Peter’s and John’s boldness and realized they were uneducated, ordinary men, they were amazed. They also recognized that these men had been with Jesus.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Now seeing the boldness of Peter and John and perceiving that they were uneducated and ordinary men, they were marveling, and they recognized that they had been with Jesus.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps both speakers, direct appeal, rightness before God, and competing obedience.
key_decisions.before: But Peter and John answered, “Whether it is right in God’s sight to listen to you rather than to God, judge for yourselves.
key_decisions.after: But Peter and John answered them, “Judge for yourselves whether it is right before God to listen to you rather than to God.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But Peter and John answered and said to them, “Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, judge for yourselves;

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves hearing, united prayer, sovereign address, creation, and comprehensive contents.
key_decisions.before: When the community heard it, they raised their voices together to God: “Master, you are the one who made heaven, earth, sea, and everything in them.
key_decisions.after: When they heard it, they raised their voices together to God and said, “Sovereign Lord, you made heaven, earth, sea, and everything in them.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And hearing it, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord and said, “Master, you are the one who made the heaven and the earth and the sea and all that is in them,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps divine speech, Spirit, David, servant, nations, peoples, and empty plotting.
key_decisions.before: You said by the Holy Spirit through the mouth of our ancestor David your servant: ‘Why did the nations rage, and the peoples plan empty things?
key_decisions.after: You spoke by the Holy Spirit through the mouth of our ancestor David, your servant: ‘Why did the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: who through the Holy Spirit, by the mouth of our father David your servant, said, ‘Why did the nations rage, and the peoples imagine vain things?

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps city, named rulers, Gentiles, Israel, gathering, servant, Jesus, and anointing.
key_decisions.before: For truly in this city Herod and Pontius Pilate, together with the Gentiles and the peoples of Israel, gathered against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed,
key_decisions.after: For truly, in this city Herod and Pontius Pilate, together with the Gentiles and the peoples of Israel, gathered against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: "For in this city, in fact, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the gentiles and the peoples of Israel, gathered together against your holy servant[j] Jesus, whom you anointed,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves human action within divine power and prior purpose.
key_decisions.before: to do whatever your hand and purpose had determined beforehand would happen.
key_decisions.after: They did whatever your hand and your plan had determined beforehand would happen.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: to do whatever your hand and your purpose had predestined to take place.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves multitude, unity, heart, soul, private claim, contrast, and sharing.
key_decisions.before: The whole community of those who trusted was one in heart and life. No one claimed that any possession was exclusively their own, but they held everything in common.
key_decisions.after: The whole community of believers was one in heart and soul. No one claimed that any possession belonged privately to them; instead, they held everything in common.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And the multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul, and not even one was saying that anything of the things belonging to him was his own, but they had all things in common.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves absence of need and owners’ voluntary selling and proceeds.
key_decisions.before: There was not a needy person among them, because those who owned lands or houses sold them, brought the proceeds from what was sold,
key_decisions.after: There was not a needy person among them, because those who owned fields or houses sold them and brought the proceeds
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For there was not a needy person among them, for as many as were owners of lands or houses were selling them and bringing the proceeds of the things sold

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps placement, apostolic stewardship, individual distribution, and need criterion.
key_decisions.before: and laid the money at the apostles’ feet. It was distributed to each person according to need.
key_decisions.after: and laid them at the apostles’ feet. The money was then distributed to each person according to need.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and laying them at the feet of the apostles, and it was being distributed to each as anyone had need.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves birth name, given name and translation, tribe, and origin.
key_decisions.before: Joseph, whom the apostles called Barnabas—which means Son of Encouragement—a Levite and native of Cyprus,
key_decisions.after: Joseph, whom the apostles called Barnabas—which means Son of Encouragement—was a Levite from Cyprus.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And Joseph, who was called by the apostles Barnabas (which means, being translated, Son of Encouragement), a Levite, a native of Cyprus,
